decisions.why: All three examples (Mirage Bath Mat, Bath Towel, Hand Towel) are hospital linen/towels, homogeneous.
Both examples (Warm Up Jacket Mid Green/Blue) are clinical staff workwear jackets, not PPE despite division label.
Single product THERMARMOUR Medical Cap is part of the THERMARMOUR patient warming range, fits patient warming & temperature.
Single product Reusable 3ply Face Masks is general PPE.
